item.title: Layers 0.1.3
item.description: Lower the Layers system requirement to macOS 14 Sonoma, with Apple Silicon and Intel builds. Keep the existing material fallback on older macOS versions; Liquid Glass remains available on compatible newer systems. Add detailed English and German GitHub guides covering setup, use cases, supported apps, profile persistence, privacy, updates and troubleshooting. Individual third-party apps can require a newer macOS version than Layers itself.
